meta.note: Config + optional cached trend counts. Every paper and window summary is fetched live from PubMed in the browser, so nothing here is model-generated. Refresh trend cache any time with python3 scripts/fetch_autophagy.py.
meta.note2: The scope is intentionally the WHOLE autophagy literature across all journals and labs, not only autophagy-dedicated groups. Themes are facets used to slice that literature toward Prof. Manjithaya's interests.

researcher.name: Prof. Ravi Manjithaya
researcher.affiliation: Molecular Biology & Genetics Unit / Neuroscience Unit, JNCASR, Bengaluru
researcher.blurb: Mechanisms of autophagy and selective autophagy in health and disease — across yeast, Drosophila, mouse and mammalian cells — spanning neurodegeneration, intracellular infection, cancer, unconventional protein secretion, and small-molecule autophagy modulators.

baseQuery: ("autophagy"[tiab] OR "autophagic"[tiab] OR "autophagosome"[tiab] OR "autophagosomes"[tiab] OR "macroautophagy"[tiab] OR "mitophagy"[tiab] OR "aggrephagy"[tiab] OR "pexophagy"[tiab] OR "xenophagy"[tiab] OR "lysosomal degradation"[tiab] OR "LC3"[tiab] OR "ATG8"[tiab])
prestigeJournals: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

themes.label: Mitophagy
themes.connector: these groups have new mitophagy work

themes.label: Aggrephagy & synucleinopathy
themes.query: ("aggrephagy"[tiab] OR (("alpha-synuclein"[tiab] OR "α-synuclein"[tiab] OR "synuclein"[tiab] OR "protein aggregate"[tiab] OR "protein aggregates"[tiab] OR "aggresome"[tiab]) AND ("autophagy"[tiab] OR "autophagic"[tiab] OR "clearance"[tiab])))
themes.youText: You've studied autophagic clearance of α-synuclein aggregates
themes.connector: these groups are clearing aggregates too

themes.label: Pexophagy
themes.youText: Your early work defined pexophagy in Pichia

themes.label: Xenophagy & infection
themes.query: ("xenophagy"[tiab] OR (("Salmonella"[tiab] OR "Mycobacterium"[tiab] OR "Acinetobacter"[tiab] OR "intracellular bacteria"[tiab] OR "intracellular pathogen"[tiab] OR "Plasmodium"[tiab]) AND ("autophagy"[tiab] OR "autophagic"[tiab] OR "LC3"[tiab])))
themes.youText: You've probed how autophagy handles intracellular pathogens
themes.connector: these groups are working on autophagy in infection

themes.label: ER-phagy & other selective autophagy
themes.youText: You work across selective autophagy pathways
themes.connector: these groups report new selective-autophagy routes

themes.label: Secretory & unconventional protein secretion
themes.query: ("unconventional protein secretion"[tiab] OR "unconventional secretion"[tiab] OR "secretory autophagy"[tiab] OR ("autophagy"[tiab] AND "secretion"[tiab] AND "Golgi"[tiab]))
themes.youText: You connected autophagosome biogenesis to unconventional secretion
themes.connector: these groups are working on secretory autophagy

themes.label: Core machinery & regulation
themes.query: (("ATG"[tiab] OR "ULK1"[tiab] OR "Beclin"[tiab] OR "WIPI2"[tiab] OR "phagophore"[tiab] OR "autophagosome biogenesis"[tiab] OR "mTOR"[tiab] OR "mTORC1"[tiab] OR "AMPK"[tiab] OR "TFEB"[tiab]) AND ("autophagy"[tiab] OR "autophagic"[tiab]))
themes.youText: Your mechanistic work maps the autophagy machinery

themes.label: Neurodegeneration
themes.query: (("Parkinson"[tiab] OR "Alzheimer"[tiab] OR "neurodegeneration"[tiab] OR "neurodegenerative"[tiab] OR "tau"[tiab] OR "TDP-43"[tiab] OR "Huntington"[tiab] OR "ALS"[tiab] OR "amyotrophic lateral sclerosis"[tiab]) AND ("autophagy"[tiab] OR "autophagic"[tiab] OR "mitophagy"[tiab] OR "lysosom"[tiab]))
themes.youText: You model autophagy failure in neurodegeneration
themes.connector: these groups link autophagy to neurodegeneration

themes.label: Autophagy in cancer
themes.query: (("cancer"[tiab] OR "tumor"[tiab] OR "tumour"[tiab] OR "pancreatic"[tiab] OR "oncogen"[tiab]) AND ("autophagy"[tiab] OR "autophagic"[tiab] OR "mitophagy"[tiab]))
themes.youText: You've explored autophagy in cancer, including pancreatic
themes.connector: these groups tie autophagy to tumor biology

themes.label: Small-molecule autophagy modulators
themes.query: (("autophagy"[tiab] OR "autophagic"[tiab] OR "mitophagy"[tiab]) AND ("small molecule"[tiab] OR "small-molecule"[tiab] OR "autophagy inducer"[tiab] OR "autophagy inhibitor"[tiab] OR "autophagy modulator"[tiab] OR "high-content screen"[tiab] OR "high content screening"[tiab] OR "drug discovery"[tiab] OR "chemical screen"[tiab]))
themes.connector: these groups report new autophagy-modulating compounds
